definitions.gloss: to shake one's head (in denial or refusal)
definitions.explanation: To move one's head side to side to indicate 'no' or disagreement.

definitions.gloss: to nod (only when vertical movement is specified)
definitions.explanation: When specified as vertical movement, indicates agreement or acknowledgment.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{首|くび}を{振|ふ}った。
examples.english: "It's impossible," he said, shaking his head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{頼|たの}んでも→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{首|くび}を⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}る⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だった。
examples.english: No matter how many times I asked, she just kept shaking her head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黙|だま}って→黙る：02287_damaru⟧{首|くび}を⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}った。⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor silently shook his head. Seeing his expression, the family prepared themselves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{首|くび}を⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}っていた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{説得|せっとく}→説得：14219_settoku⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{首|くび}を⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}った。
examples.english: At first she shook her head no, but after being persuaded, she finally nodded yes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首|くび}を⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}った。
examples.english: She nodded in response to the question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しそうに→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{首|くび}を⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}った。
「⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧？」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧{首|くび}を⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}った。
examples.english: When I asked "Do you understand?" he gave a small nod.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{首|くび}を⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}って、⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: She nodded emphatically to show her agreement.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧？」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}かれて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{首|くび}を⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}った。⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: When asked "Do you want to go?" I nodded repeatedly. I'm really looking forward to it.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {首|くび} (neck/head) + を + {振|ふ}る (to shake/swing)

DIRECTION MATTERS:
- {首|くび}を⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}る: shake head side to side (no, disagreement)
- {首|くび}を⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}る: nod (yes, agreement)
- Without direction specified, usually implies side-to-side (no)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦うなずく→頷く：05544_unazuku⟧ (to nod) - specifically means agreement/understanding
- ⟦{頷|うなず}く→頷く：05544_unazuku⟧ (same as above, kanji form)
- {首|くび}をかしげる (to tilt one's head) - shows puzzlement

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, as in most cultures, shaking the head side-to-side means 'no' and nodding means 'yes.' However, Japanese people may also tilt the head or say "うーん" to soften refusal.
